The axis no catalog publishes: "good for code" is not a capability declared by any provider, it is the operator's opinion — and applies ONLY to this workspace (ADR 0049). Axis independent of activation: marking a use does not turn the model on in the selector, and changing the use does not turn off what was on. The uses list REPLACES the previous one.
